annotation.title_clean: Commission Regulation (EU) No 347/2012 implementing Regulation (EC) No 661/2009 with respect to type-approval requirements for certain categories of motor vehicles with regard to advanced emergency braking systems
annotation.title_en: Commission Regulation (EU) No 347/2012 implementing Regulation (EC) No 661/2009 with respect to type-approval requirements for certain categories of motor vehicles with regard to advanced emergency braking systems
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 109/1
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission regulation setting type-approval requirements for advanced emergency braking systems (AEBS) in heavy vehicles (M2, M3, N2, N3). It defines two approval levels, test procedures, warning and failure requirements, and electronic safety documentation, with phased dates banning registration of non-compliant new vehicles.
key_provisions_or_claims: AEBS mandatory type-approval for M2, M3, N2, N3 vehicles with listed exemptions
Two-stage approval levels 1 and 2 with phased dates 2013-2018
Collision warning and emergency braking tests with stationary and moving targets
Failure detection, deactivation and false reaction tests
Annex III requires safety concept, FMEA/FTA documentation for complex electronic control systems
